description: Look up a member and read the account holder's name from their detail page.

member_id.description: the member id to use for this run

target.reasoning: role='textbox' name='Search (ID / name)' resolves to exactly one element across the page and its frames. Backed by real semantic HTML (a real <button>, <label for>, or <th scope=row> - see app/templates), not any CSS class or test ID, so it survives markup/styling churn and only breaks if the visible label text or the element's semantic role itself changes.
